# Shibaji Debnath - System Architect & Fractional CTO, Mentor

- Fractional CTO Advisory & Architectural Audits
- Software Engineering Courses & Mentorship

## Published Architectural Blueprints & Articles
- [Self-Hosting n8n & Ollama on a VPS: Production AI Workflows Without Third-Party API Bills](https://shibajidebnath.com/articles/n8n-hostinger-vps-ollama-setup): Learn how to bypass recurring OpenAI and Anthropic token charges by deploying self-hosted n8n and Ollama on a Hostinger VPS. This guide walks through Linux server configuration, Docker provisioning, and running private AI agents 24/7.
- [How to Build a 100% Free Local AI Chatbot with n8n, Flowise & Ollama](https://shibajidebnath.com/articles/n8n-flowise-local-ai-setup): A beginner-friendly, zero-code architectural guide on running private AI chatbots locally using Docker, n8n, Flowise, and Ollama without recurring API bills.

## Software Engineering Courses & Bootcamps
- [Advanced React 19, Concurrency & Enterprise Design Systems](https://shibajidebnath.com/courses/advanced-react-performance-architecture): 12-week comprehensive React masterclass featuring 24 live interactive sessions, sub-millisecond render profiling, TanStack Query cache synchronization, accessible Radix UI primitives, and Core Web Vitals optimization.
- [Autonomous Agentic AI, MCP Server Architecture & Applied LLMs](https://shibajidebnath.com/courses/autonomous-agentic-ai-mcp-architecture): 16-week applied AI engineering accelerator featuring 32 live interactive sessions, custom MCP protocol development, LangGraph stateful agent graphs, Qdrant/pgvector embedding pipelines, and enterprise LLM production deployments.
- [Enterprise Angular, Signals & Scalable Architecture](https://shibajidebnath.com/courses/enterprise-angular-scalable-architecture): 12-week enterprise Angular masterclass featuring 24 live interactive sessions, Zoneless change detection, advanced HTTP interceptor architectures, NgRx/Signals state stores, and automated testing with Vitest/Playwright.
- [Enterprise NestJS, Event-Driven Architectures & CQRS](https://shibajidebnath.com/courses/enterprise-nestjs-cqrs-architecture): 24-week backend engineering accelerator featuring 48 live interactive sessions, strict Domain-Driven Design (DDD), asynchronous message brokers, distributed transactional outbox pattern, and production-grade CQRS monorepos.
- [Full-Stack Docker, VPS & Production Deployment Crash Course](https://shibajidebnath.com/courses/fullstack-docker-vps-deployment-crash-course): 4-week fast-track cohort featuring 8 live sessions, multi-stage Docker builds, PostgreSQL containerization, Traefik/Nginx reverse proxy, automated Let's Encrypt SSL, and live VPS deployment.
- [High-Performance PostgreSQL Internals, Distributed Data & Query Optimization](https://shibajidebnath.com/courses/high-performance-postgresql-internals): 12-week database engineering accelerator featuring 24 live interactive sessions, EXPLAIN ANALYZE execution plan tearing, buffer pool tuning, PgBouncer architecture, horizontal table partitioning, and high-availability streaming replication.
- [Cross-Platform Mobile App Engineering with React Native & Expo](https://shibajidebnath.com/courses/mobile-app-engineering-react-native): 12-week mobile app engineering track featuring 24 live interactive sessions, native gesture handling with Reanimated, SQLite offline synchronization, push notifications, and automated EAS app store builds.
- [Modern Frontend Engineering with React, Astro & TypeScript](https://shibajidebnath.com/courses/modern-frontend-react-astro): 12-week comprehensive frontend journey featuring 24 live interactive sessions, TanStack Query data fetching, state management with Zustand, accessibility standards, and sub-second Core Web Vitals optimization.
- [Modern PHP 8.x, Symfony Components & Production Architecture](https://shibajidebnath.com/courses/modern-php-symfony-architecture): 12-week backend mastery featuring 24 live interactive sessions, strict typing, Composer package design, Doctrine ORM query optimization, Redis caching, and automated testing with PHPUnit.
- [Production Flutter & Dart Mobile App Engineering](https://shibajidebnath.com/courses/production-flutter-dart-engineering): 12-week comprehensive Flutter program featuring 24 live interactive sessions, rigorous Clean Architecture separation, custom render box animations, REST/GraphQL integration, and automated store deployments.
- [Production Kubernetes, Bare-Metal VPS & Cloud-Native DevOps](https://shibajidebnath.com/courses/production-kubernetes-baremetal-devops): 16-week production DevOps accelerator featuring 32 live interactive sessions, custom VPS kernel tuning, multi-node Kubernetes clustering (K3s/k8s), automated Let's Encrypt SSL orchestration, and GitOps pipelines.
- [Enterprise System Architecture, Microservices & Autonomous AI Engineering](https://shibajidebnath.com/courses/system-architecture-mastery): 48-week flagship mentorship program featuring 96 live interactive sessions, production architecture teardowns, BullMQ distributed caching, PostgreSQL internals, Kubernetes orchestration, and bare-metal VPS deployment.
